market_holds: Spot $2.62-2.65 (baseline 18:08 UTC), at the 52-week low, -8.9% over 5 sessions and -28.6% over 20 sessions. That fall is the fade of the ESMO three-year EVX-01 pop (Oct 19-23, to $4.05). There are no options, and the baseline has no earnings history because of the SEC 403. Past earnings days, close to close from Yahoo bars: Q3'25 2025-11-19 -7.2%, FY25 2026-03-05 +9.3%, Q1'26 2026-05-07 -7.7%, Q2'26 2026-08-20 +4.1% (open +7.9%). That is roughly 7% either way with no directional habit. 20-day realised volatility is 85%, so a one-day noise band is about 5.4%. Market cap is about $24M: 9.22M ADS from the share capital of DKK 115.28M in the 2026-11-04 6-K, at 50 shares per ADS. Cash was $14.0M at June 30, and the company has guided runway into 2H27 for four quarters, with a 2026 operating burn of about $14M. There is no meaningful consensus; one tracker shows EPS -$0.01. Since the last report the company has used its ATM twice, on Aug 19-21 (681k ADS, net $2.11M) and Oct 19-21 (201k ADS at $3.97, net $0.78M), each time into a rally. The EIB warrant resale F-1 went effective on 2026-11-13: 769k ADS at $4.87, out of the money. New today: the 2026-11-18 6-K renames tomorrow's report a 'strategy and business update' with an 08:30 ET call. The calendar set in Nov 2025 said only 'business update'. The stock opened at $2.52, -9.4% against $2.78, on about 48k shares in the first 15 minutes, more than half the day's volume, while XBI was flat. It then recovered to about $2.62 (-5.8%). The price therefore already carries a discount of about 6% for the possibility that the strategy update is bad news.
view: The Q3 numbers will not move this stock. My own estimate of Q3 cash is about $12.6M ($14.0M + $2.1M ATM - about $3.5M burn), which covers the roughly $10.5M needed to reach mid-2027. So the 2H27 runway claim most likely survives, and the swing from Q3'25 net income (the one-off $7.5M MSD EVX-B3 payment) to a loss is known. The reaction will come from the strategy update, which was added to the title one day ahead under a CEO who has been in post a year and made her name in partnering. Plausible contents, each one public only tomorrow: (a) a reprioritisation or restructuring toward partnering the AI platform and assets, with programs cut or a smaller staff. That is ambiguous and often sold in microcaps, though a longer runway would be welcome. (b) A partnership or licence. That would be strongly positive on a $24M market cap, but management has said only 'several parallel partnership discussions', with no counterparty trace I could find. (c) A financing or a strategic-alternatives review, which would be negative. On the other side, management has sold ATM stock into every rally (Aug and Oct), which caps any pop, and microcap biotech drifts down. The open today already took about 6% off for the uncertainty. I lean slightly down but cannot show the deciding line, so this is not a call.

recommendation.reason: The deciding line is the content of a strategy update that was flagged only a day ahead, and no public trace shows which way it goes: no deal counterparty, no layoff or WARN-type trace, no new offering filing. The price already discounted about 6% today on the announcement. The cash arithmetic says the runway claim holds, so the Q3 numbers themselves are not a surprise. The remaining slight negative lean (ATM selling into strength, a restructuring-type update, microcap drift) is far short of 65%.
recommendation.what_would_flip_it: A signed partnership or licence with upfront cash in tomorrow's release would make this sharply up. A concurrent registered direct or underwritten offering, or a strategic-alternatives review, would make the down lean much stronger.

self_critique: A strategy update announced a day ahead by a partnering-focused CEO could just as well frame a deal. Biotech microcaps sometimes save a licence for the results day, and on a $24M market cap with about $12M of cash any upfront payment would move the stock a lot. Today's 6-9% drop may also have been an overreaction, leaving room for a relief bounce if the update turns out to be a simple refocus with the runway intact. Against that, the company's ATM habit and the absence of any deal trace keep me just below 50, not above it.
